instruction: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, locate information about identity verification requirements for opening a bank account and save the accepted documents list in a text file named identity_verification_documents.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, search for identity verification requirements for opening a bank account.
Open a relevant bank or government website.
Find the list of accepted identity verification documents.
Type or copy the accepted documents list into the document.
Save the file as identity_verification_documents.txt on the Desktop.
Leave the saved file on the Desktop.
